question: Should yielded main-session rows expose `paused` as the durable persisted and gateway-visible session status, distinct from the broader `deferred` parent/task vocabulary proposed elsewhere?
rationale: The runtime bug and patch correctness are well supported, but adding a stored/API status and choosing its relationship to `deferred` is a compatibility-sensitive product contract that code review cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept session `paused`
options.body: Land this PR with `paused` reserved for session-run state while any `deferred` term remains scoped to cron or parent-task lifecycle.

options.title: Rename to `deferred`
options.body: Mechanically align the persisted session status, reason, tests, and UI strings with the broader proposal before merge.

options.title: Define one shared model first
options.body: Hold both PRs until maintainers specify a single cross-surface yielded-parent lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Accept session `paused`
recommendation.body: Land this PR with `paused` reserved for session-run state while any `deferred` term remains scoped to cron or parent-task lifecycle.
